title: HtmlInputImage
responsibility: Renders the native input control with type image without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: HtmlInputImage.children
inputs.description: Optional Svelte snippet read from `children` when the component receives props. The component does not insert it into the `<input type="image">` body, which remains a void element.

outputs.name: HtmlInputImage
outputs.description: The component renders a native `<input>` with type `image` and spreads every remaining prop onto it. It adds no wrapper or child content.
